title: Managed Backup: backup storage
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines backup storage.

## Tier basis

**Included storage multiple.** Included backup storage as a multiple of protected source quantity; decimal.

**Excess backup storage rate.** Backup storage above inclusion; USD per GB-month.

| Contract tier | Included storage multiple | Excess backup storage rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 1 | 0.024 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 1 | 0.024 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 1 | 0.024 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 1 | 0.024 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 1 | 0.024 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | 1 | 0.024 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, included storage multiple is 1.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, included storage multiple stays the same.
